content.comment_body: Hello, I recently bought a new [product_name], and wasn't able to connect until I updated to [product_name] [version_no]. Now, however, the online test feature doesn't work as reliably as before. Specifically, I'm unable to view my analog values.
I also have the new [product_name] [version_no] and can't see any differences in the online test compared to previous versions of [product_name] like [version_no].
That's unusual. Please check the attached screenshot.
I've noticed this issue too—see my attachment for details. One of the slave devices appears twice as an 'unknown device,' and both have the same IP address. Could this be related?
You should consider starting a support request.
Thanks. If I or support find a solution, I'll update you all.
Thank you, that would be very helpful. It might benefit others if we figure out the cause.

Hi, there is a change in how parameters are displayed in the online test for [product_name] [version_no]. To see a specific parameter, move your mouse cursor over the function block; after a moment, you'll see an icon (spectacles). Click on it, and the parameter will appear. I hope this helps.

I highlighted two areas in red in the screenshot from the original post. There, you can see the small 'x' icon on the right but no numerical values in front of it. Based on this, it seems the glasses icon was used. Also, in the network view screenshot, the FS4 slave [product_name] and the [article_no].Standard [product_name] (far right, Unknown_1) share the same IP address.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report issues viewing analog values in the online test after updating to [product_name] [version_no]. The issue may be related to how devices are recognized, with a slave device shown twice under the same IP address but with different statuses. Some community members do not see this problem, suggesting it may depend on specific settings or setups. The method for viewing parameters in online mode has changed, but at least one user confirms using the correct approach, indicating the problem is not due to misunderstanding the UI.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to view all analog values seamlessly in online test mode and for device recognition in the network to be reliable—without duplicate entries or ambiguity.
